description: Summarises the backlinks of a domain or page: referring domains, domain rank, new and lost links, and top anchors. Use it to size a site's authority. It spends from the user's own DataForSEO account inside the extension, within the monthly cap set there; a call over the cap is refused with an error saying so, and a cached answer from the last 7 days costs nothing. The agent never sees the key. If the user's DataForSEO plan has no Backlinks access, an error says so.

target.description: A domain without a scheme (acme.example) or a full page URL to summarise.

name: backlinks_summary
title: Backlinks summary
